title: eriophorum angustifolium var. gracile
intro: Eriophorum angustifolium var. gracile, commonly known as the slender cotton-grass, is a variety of the cotton-grass plant native to North America. The slender cotton-grass has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include wound healing, soothing skin irritations, and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of the slender cotton-grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
